name: Ritual Backlash
disable: DC 20 Occultism check or DC 20 Religion check three times to suppress the backlash of energy, or defeat Viro Ahala
reset: Once Viro Ahala has been defeated, this trap can't be reset.
routine: (3 actions) The hazard makes a ranged mindburn Strike, creates a Pulse of Fear, and bestows Vitality of Hell to Viro or one of his allies at random. If it's reduced to 2 actions, the hazard doesn't create a Pulse of Fear. If reduced to 1 action, the hazard only bestows Vitality of Hell.

items.name: Pulse of Fear
items.text: Each of Viro's enemies in a 20-foot emanation from the ivory bowl must succeed at a DC 18 Will save save or become Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure).

items.name: Vitality of Hell
items.text:
Viro or one of his allies gains 1d6 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 round.

Effect: Vitality of Hell

items.name: Lash Out
items.text:
Trigger Viro Ahala rolls initiative

---
Effect Viro's lack of full attention unleashes the latent magical energy of the cave. The hazard creates a Pulse of Fear and then rolls initiative.

text: The space above the flame in the ivory bowl wavers and the smell of brimstone assaults the senses.
